50831999.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length N-terminal 6xHis-Smt3 tagged human Ube2T expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) by ITC

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: ITC experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. Ube2T (100 μM) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.01% Tween 20. The protein was loaded into the sample cell, and the ligand (EM04, 1.5 mM) was loaded into the syringe. The ligand was injected in 20 steps of 2 μL each, with 120 s between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated as the reciprocal of the association constant (Ka).
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: EM04 binds Ube2T with a Kd = 1.3 mM (ΔH = 0.36 kcal mol−1), as measured by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) (SI, Figure S7A).

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween 20
